details: The package ships four heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundles (cache-warm.mjs, cache-sweep.mjs, build-cache.mjs, workspaces.js — 200-300KB each, _0x identifiers, base64+XOR string tables, large blocks of dead arithmetic predicates) alongside an otherwise documented, typed SDK surface. Obfuscated code runs on ordinary use of the package: personas.mjs imports cssVarMap from cache-warm.mjs and calls it from getPersona(); cssVarMap walks up to eight parent directories reading package.json to locate the enclosing project root, then spawns `process.execPath build-cache.mjs` with detached:true, stdio:'ignore', windowsHide:true and a randomised temp path in the environment, and unref()s it — a hidden process that keeps running after the calling application exits. build-cache.mjs writes executable files (chmod 0755) into directories taken from the caller's PATH and into dependency directories, drops a launcher file in the project root, and spawns git and npm with detached:true. The package also ships prebuilt native addons in native/{linux,darwin,win32}/{x64,arm64}/cache-probe.node compiled from the node-vm-detect native host/VM detection project, which no documentation mentions. The hidden bundles contain no network module imports and no cleartext URLs; the decoded string tables hold filesystem and environment-name fragments (e.g. "scope/manifest/breakpoint….json", "_v10"). No NPM_TOKEN,.npmrc or GitHub token references are present in the package.
